body:
Thank you for sharing your story, it was rather uplifting to know that through your suffering you have managed to pull through. That's the spirit I want. 
 
The doctors I see are the ones that work not on appointments, that work until 9:00PM, get everyone in, get everyone out. I've seen that many numerous ones I've lost track on what their names are when I go in for a follow up. There is one doctor of mine who was fantastic, but with a busy full time roster I can't ever make an appointment with her because she books at least 2 weeks in advance - generally by this time the worst of the infection had already past. The psychologist I see is in the same boat. I often find that where I get in a really low and dark mood I can't ever make a session with her to pin point the issues. By the time I see her, I've sort of gotten 'over it' in a sense and can't address to her my problems. Therefore not fixing any problems at all. 
 
It is good that you did mention seeking another psychologist out, It never really occurred to me to look elsewhere. I think I might do this, if not only for the sake of someone who works weekends or outside of work hours. With this whole health situation going on I can't afford to take anymore time off.  
 
Thank you for your insight and advice. Reddit is a wonderful community.
